_comment: Committed expected values for the witnessed-anchor vector. run_anchor.py recomputes every one of these from the committed artifacts in this directory plus the two committed envelopes under examples/ — Python stdlib only, including the Ed25519 verification. Nothing here is taken on trust; if the log ever served a different leaf, a different proof, or an unsigned checkpoint, the runner fails.
_provenance: Leaves appended by the log operator (MarkovianProtocol, log.markovianprotocol.com) at our request in erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts#77 — leaf 6312 (authorized envelope) and leaf 6371 (post-revocation envelope), both 2026-08-03. Artifacts fetched from that log's public endpoints; checkpoint snapshot taken 2026-08-04 at tree size 6492.
